text: PaVeToABCD[expr] converts suitable PaVe functions to direct Passarino-Veltman functions (A0, A00, B0, B1, B00, B11, C0, D0). PaVeToABCD is nearly the inverse of ToPaVe2.
Overview, ToPaVe, ToPaVe2, A0, A00, B0, B1, B00, B11, C0, D0.
PaVe[0, {SPD[p1], 0, SPD[p2]}, {m1^2, m2^2, m3^2}] ex = PaVeToABCD[%]
ex // FCI // StandardForm (*C0[0, Pair[Momentum[p1, D], Momentum[p1, D]], Pair[Momentum[p2, D], Momentum[p2, D]], m3^2, m2^2, m1^2]*)
PaVe[0, 0, {SPD[p1], 0, SPD[p2]}, {m1^2, m2^2, m3^2}] ex = PaVeToABCD[%]
ex // FCI // StandardForm (*PaVe[0, 0, {0, Pair[Momentum[p1, D], Momentum[p1, D]], Pair[Momentum[p2, D], Momentum[p2, D]]}, {m3^2, m2^2, m1^2}]*)
